glosses: edge, border, brink, verge, rim, margin
brim, rim, lip (top edge of a vessel or container)
side (of the road, highway, freeway, etc.)

examples.text: Ella está al borde de una crisis nerviosa.
examples.en: She is on the verge of a nervous breakdown.

examples.text: No pongas el vaso cerca del borde de la mesa.
examples.en: Don't put the glass near the edge of the table.
